password.rules: At least 12 characters. Passwords that are too common are refused. A passphrase is easy to remember and hard to guess.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
password.tooShort: The password must be at least 12 characters long.
password.rejected: This password is not accepted: it is too short or too common. Choose another one.

stepTimeout: This step must be completed within 5 minutes. If you reload the page, you will have to start again from the beginning.

setup.title: TransTeira setup
setup.intro: Create the super administrator account. This account manages every entity and every administrator. Two-factor authentication is configured right after.

username.label: Username
username.hint: 3 to 64 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore. Starts with a letter or a digit.

email.label: Email address
email.hint: It receives the super administrator alerts, such as the disk space alert.

setupToken.label: Setup token
setupToken.hint: It protects this page until the first account is created. If it was not set with the TT_SETUP_TOKEN or TT_SETUP_TOKEN_FILE variable, TransTeira generated it at startup and wrote it to its log (docker logs command).

setup.tokenInvalid: The setup token is not valid. Check it in the server log or in the TT_SETUP_TOKEN variable.
setup.alreadyDone: The setup has already been completed. Sign in with the existing account.
setup.nextStep: Account created. Now configure two-factor authentication.
setup.done: Setup complete. Welcome to the administration.

enroll.title: Configure two-factor authentication
enroll.intro: Two-factor authentication protects your account even if your password is compromised.
enroll.requiredIntro: Two-factor authentication is required for your account. Configure it to continue.
enroll.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone or computer (for example a TOTP-compatible app or your password manager).
enroll.step2: Scan the QR code below, or enter the key manually.
enroll.step3: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app to confirm.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code to configure two-factor authentication. If you cannot scan it, use the key shown below.
enroll.qrUnavailable: The QR code could not be displayed. Enter the key manually in your app.

manualKey.label: Setup key
manualKey.hint: Enter it without the spaces if your app asks for it. Type: time-based (TOTP).

enroll.invalid: The code is not correct. Check the time of your device, then enter the new code.
enroll.expired: The configuration has expired. Start again to get a new key.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.intro: These codes let you sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app. Each code can be used only once.
recovery.shownOnce: They will never be shown again. Save them now in a safe place, such as your password manager.
recovery.fileHeader: TransTeira recovery codes for the account {username}. Each code can be used only once.
recovery.fileHeaderGeneric: TransTeira recovery codes. Each code can be used only once.
recovery.announced: Your recovery codes are displayed. Save them before continuing.
recovery.acknowledge: I have saved these recovery codes in a safe place.
recovery.acknowledgeRequired: Confirm that you have saved your recovery codes.

leaveConfirm.title: Leave without saving your recovery codes?
leaveConfirm.text: They will never be shown again. Without them, losing your authenticator app locks you out of your account.

activation.title: Activate your account
activation.intro: Choose the password of your administration account.

invalidLink.title: Invalid activation link
invalidLink.text: This activation link is not valid, has already been used or has expired. Ask a super administrator for a new one.

password.title: Change password
password.otherSessions: Your other open sessions will be closed. This session stays active.
password.currentInvalid: The current password is not correct.

reenroll.title: Change authentication device
reenroll.text: Configure a new authenticator app. The previous one will stop working and new recovery codes will replace the previous ones.
reenroll.confirmText: Enter your current password to continue.

disable.title: Disable two-factor authentication
disable.text: Your account will be protected by your password only. Your recovery codes will be deleted.
disable.confirmText: Enter your current password to confirm.
disable.forbidden: Two-factor authentication is required for your account: it cannot be disabled.
